question: Which powers are invoked to be present on the calf and on the sole of the foot?
premises: Vyāghrī and Cakrī are invoked on the calf.
Mahī is invoked on the sole of the foot.
Their presence is requested as a blessing.
inference: Vyāghrī and Cakrī are invoked on the calf, and Mahī on the sole.
uncertainties: The form syātu is unusual here and may reflect a textual variant.
plain_english: May Vyāghrī and Cakrī be on the calf, and may Mahī be on the sole of the foot.
